title: A protection that must never remove the last copy is decided per recommendation, not by counting the whole library
rule: When a recommendation may not remove the last copy of something (a font held by collection files, a file several sets share), do not mark it by counting holders over the whole library ('only one file holds it'). Decide it after ranking, per recommendation: while the copies this recommendation would remove hold an item that no file outside them holds, keep the best-ranked of them, and repeat. Test it with two identical holders that are both in the removal set plus one copy that wins, and assert one holder stays.
rationale: E56.4 (#664): fonts_only_here counted two identical .ttc files as two holders of a font, so neither was protected and the Foo set recommended removing both, the only copies of Bar (criterion 7).
